title: HPE Aruba EdgeConnect overview
description: Comprehensive monitoring for HPE Aruba EdgeConnect SD-WAN appliances. Track fleet health, tunnel performance, and interface utilization.

definition.content:
## HPE Aruba EdgeConnect Overview

This dashboard provides a high-level overview of your HPE Aruba EdgeConnect SD-WAN appliances. It is organized into sections covering fleet health, device health, interface health and traffic, tunnel performance, network quality, QoS and traffic shaping, circuit SLA, and application experience. 

All metrics are collected through the HPE Aruba EdgeConnect Orchestrator and appliance APIs.

### Further Reading

- [HPE Aruba Networking EdgeConnect SD-WAN](https://www.hpe.com/us/en/aruba-edgeconnect-sd-wan.html)
- [HPE Aruba Networking EdgeConnect SD-WAN API](https://developer.arubanetworks.com/edgeconnect/docs/making-api-requests)
- [HPE Aruba Networking EdgeConnect SD-WAN Logs](https://arubanetworking.hpe.com/techdocs/sdwan/docs/white-paper/appliance-logs/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
High-level health of all EdgeConnect appliances to spot outages, hardware faults, resource pressure, and recent reboots at a glance.
CPU, memory, and disk utilization metrics to identify appliances under resource pressure before they impact network performance.
Interface-level traffic, utilization, and drop metrics to identify congestion and link issues.

definition.content: Tunnel throughput and availability metrics to understand SD-WAN traffic distribution and tunnel health.
Application latency metrics to correlate network performance with user-impacting application behavior.
Latency, loss, jitter, and MOS metrics to evaluate tunnel quality and user experience.

definition.title: Tunnel packet loss by tunnel and FEC

definition.content: QoS drop and DSCP bandwidth metrics to validate traffic prioritization and detect policy issues.
Circuit-level SLA metrics to monitor WAN underlay health and detect provider or transport degradation.
Alarm activity reported by EdgeConnect appliances, including raise, clear, and delete alarm actions. Track alarm volume over time and inspect recent alarm events.

definition.title: Alarm events over time by alarm name

definition.content: High-level overview of log activity, highlighting error frequency, log volume by status, and recent failures to reflect the system’s current health and stability.
